title: A timed-out model falls back once, and the customer gets one finished answer

turns.user: Bhai family platter mein kya kya aata hai?
turns.expect: the primary model times out, the fallback answers in the same language

model.text: Family platter mein grilled chicken, seekh kebab, naan, salad aur do drinks aate hain. Chaar logon ke liye kaafi hai.

require.why: the fallback produced the real answer
